addendum_hash_recipe.note: Recompute from this committed file alone; depends on every field except addendum_hash.

against_battery.discrimination_inversion: AGAINST if the BACKWARDS hypothesis is significant: one-sided Mann-Whitney U with H1 (OK realized_net stochastically worse than AVOID) has p <= named_levels.weak. The ordering the product asserts is not merely absent but reversed - OK pools did significantly worse than AVOID.
against_battery.missed_severe: AGAINST if any OK-tier pool realizes SEVERE (realized_net < severe_net_return_threshold) - a catastrophic false-safe, judged outcome-by-outcome like the MC family's missed_trap_contradiction.
against_battery.ok_false_safe: AGAINST@level if P(X >= observed OK breaches | Binomial(n_OK, ok_tier_tolerance)) <= level. OK pools breached more than the pre-committed safe-to-hold tolerance allows.
against_battery.oor_not_idle: AGAINST if n_OOR >= 1 and P(X >= observed OUT_OF_RANGE breaches | Binomial(n_OOR, oor_tier_tolerance)) <= named_levels.weak. Out-of-range pools bled more than the pre-committed idle claim allows. Evaluated before UNTESTED-narrow (see evaluation_order).

fixed_rule.evaluation_order: INVALID first; then the OUT_OF_RANGE claim check (EVIDENCE AGAINST if oor_not_idle fires - evaluated before UNTESTED-narrow because the OUT_OF_RANGE claim does not depend on the AVOID/OK contrast, so a calm AVOID/OK window must not hide it); then UNTESTED-narrow (the cohort could not have distinguished AVOID from OK: an empty AVOID or OK group, OR zero breaches among AVOID+OK); then EVIDENCE AGAINST (any trigger in the battery); then EVIDENCE OF SKILL (only if skill is available AND all conditions hold); else UNTESTED-residual. The FIRST tier that fires decides.
fixed_rule.forecast_object: per-pool tier in {AVOID, WATCH, OK, OUT_OF_RANGE}, frozen before outcomes. OUT_OF_RANGE = price outside the frozen band at freeze (edge_margin_ticks < 0) by at least one day's normal move of the asset, i.e. |BBM| >= 1/sqrt(14) (the frozen 14-day prior under random-walk time scaling). A price outside the band by less than that is 'at the edge' and is AVOID. In band, AVOID/WATCH/OK are cut on BBM exactly as in v1. WATCH is an explicit buffer band and is EXCLUDED from every test (no hit/miss claim). OUT_OF_RANGE is EXCLUDED from the AVOID-vs-OK discrimination test and is judged ONLY by its own claim (oor_not_idle).

data_shaped: any row with per-row window_completeness < completeness_floor
any row where the resolve window's first snapshot ts != the frozen ts (entry coupling) - performed when the cohort supplies the re-check inputs; otherwise DISCLOSED, never a silent pass
ledger_shaped: any frozen row whose prior_table_hash != the cohort's committed prior_table_hash (the denominator was not the sealed prior)

fixed_rule.outcome: breached = realized_net < trap_net_return_threshold, RECOMPUTED at grade time, identical definition and vs-HODL basis to the MC-forecast family (alignment invariant).

protocol_constants.avoid_all_safe_note: An AVOID group that does not breach is NOT penalized as a false alarm: AVOID means 'fragile IF the market moves', and a calm 14-day window (no breaches anywhere) is a regime outcome, not a model error. Such a cohort is UNTESTED (could not be shown wrong), never AGAINST. This asymmetry is pre-committed.
protocol_constants.discrimination_test: Mann-Whitney U, exact, one-sided. H1: the realized_net of AVOID-tier pools is stochastically LESS (more negative) than that of OK-tier pools. Chosen deliberately over Fisher's exact on the binary breach: (1) it is threshold-free, so it does not inherit the knife-edge of the -0.05 trap line (a large fraction of outcomes sit within 0.02 of it; a Fisher 2x2 flips a pool's classification across that razor while Mann-Whitney ranks the continuous value); (2) it uses magnitude, consistent with the severity grading (a -0.30 blow-out outranks a -0.06 graze); (3) it has more power in the small, often-calm cohorts (~two dozen pools) this judge sees. The exact U null distribution is used (no normal approximation), matching the exact-inference discipline of the MC family. The BINARY breach is retained elsewhere - as the falsifiability gate for SKILL and as the OK-tier safety guards - because those claims ARE inherently binary.
protocol_constants.ok_tolerance_note: OK is the load-bearing 'safe to hold capital' claim. The pre-committed tolerance is that an OK pool breaches with probability <= 0.05; a cohort whose OK breaches are surprising under Binomial(n_OK, 0.05) is EVIDENCE AGAINST. This is the failure that matters most (false reassurance) and is judged on an ABSOLUTE bar, not relative to AVOID.
protocol_constants.oor_tolerance_note: OUT_OF_RANGE claims 'idle: this band earns no fees and does not bleed unless price returns through it'. The pre-committed tolerance is that an OUT_OF_RANGE pool breaches (realized_net < trap_net_return_threshold) with probability <= 0.10. The bar is looser than OK's 0.05 on purpose and in the open: a pool sitting just outside its edge can be dragged back through the band by a normal move; that re-entry risk is real and is what the tolerance prices. A cohort whose OUT_OF_RANGE breaches are surprising under Binomial(n_OOR, 0.10) at named_levels.weak is EVIDENCE AGAINST.
protocol_constants.skill_concentration_note: SKILL requires effective independent bets 1/HHI over the distinct ASSETS of the tested (AVOID+OK) pools >= 4.0, AND at least 3 AVOID and 3 OK calls. HHI is over assets, not pools, so a cluster of correlated same-asset pools (e.g. SOL + its liquid-staking derivatives) counts as roughly one bet, not several - a tier call spread across one asset family is not independent evidence. Pre-committed before any future cohort exists.

skill_conditions_all_required: skill_available: 1/HHI over the distinct ASSETS of AVOID+OK pools >= skill_concentration_floor AND n_AVOID >= 3 AND n_OK >= 3
falsifiable: at least 1 REAL breach occurred among AVOID+OK pools - the tiers were tested against an actual trap, not only a ranking of grazes (the product is about catching losses)
discrimination: one-sided Mann-Whitney U p(AVOID realized_net worse than OK) <= named_levels.weak
ok_protected: the ok_false_safe trigger does NOT fire, and no missed_severe
oor_idle: the oor_not_idle trigger does NOT fire (vacuous when the cohort has no OUT_OF_RANGE pool)

one_line_commitment: One pre-committed rule, parameterized only by each cohort's frozen tiers + realized breaches, applied mechanically to every future matured tier-forecast cohort to produce exactly one of four verdicts. Every threshold is derived from the cohort's own frozen inputs by the formulas below, never re-typed per cohort.

title: GradedLP STANDING Acceptance Standard - TIER-FORECAST family (BBM) v1.1 - adds the OUT_OF_RANGE claim - DRAFT, pending seal
why_v1_1: Under v2.0 a pool whose price was ALREADY outside its frozen band at freeze was tiered AVOID (BBM < 1). Such a position holds 100% of one token and its vs-HODL basis is that same token, so realized_net is ~0 unless price travels back through the band. Across the 851 matured SOL v1 outcomes re-tiered with the v2 map, out-of-band-at-freeze AVOID calls breached 6% (median realized_net 0.000) versus 42% for in-band AVOID, 2% for OK and 1% for WATCH: 'a normal move breaches' was the wrong claim for them. All 9 of those out-of-band breaches were pools within |BBM| < 0.10 of their edge (re-entry during the August move), so v2.1 keeps pools that close to the edge in AVOID via a one-day-move buffer (|BBM| >= 1/sqrt(14) to be OUT_OF_RANGE). On the same 851 outcomes that map gives OUT_OF_RANGE 0/79 breached and AVOID 35% (233). DISCLOSED AS IN-SAMPLE: the split and the need for a buffer were seen in data that shaped this standard; the buffer's value comes from time scaling of the frozen prior, not from a fit. Only cohorts frozen after this standard is sealed are ever judged by it.
